tipo: Atlas de marcos ambientais de fendas
colisao: Bases sólidas inteiramente fora do contorno caminhável; utiliza o limite existente da planta.
interiores: Base protegida da neve, com reflexos sazonais no controlador, sem precipitação.

prompts.base:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create a production game environmental SPRITE ATLAS for AlgoLand, using attached image ONLY as STYLE REFERENCE (do not edit it). Mana Seed compatible top-down 3/4 RPG perspective. TRANSPARENT background. Exactly 4 columns by 4 rows of 64x64 LOGICAL PIXEL cells: logical canvas 256x256, shown at exactly 4x nearest neighbor =1024x1024. Each visible pixel must be 4x4 output pixels, NO fine illustration detail, no antialias, no black contour. Warm gray stone, muted brown wood, subdued natural greens, upper-left light matching reference. Each separate object fits its cell with 4logicalpixel padding. Center x32 and bottom base y60 for each cell. Keep shadow compact at base, contact on ground, generous transparent empty space. No text, no grid, no floor/background squares.
Row1: broken stone arch with missing upper-right stones; tall broken mossy column on square foot; collapsed low stone wall rubble; circular ancient altar with worn spiral.
Row2: broad layered quarry boulder; three pointed cave stalagmites cluster; wooden mine support arch with diagonal braces; mine cart with dark iron rocks and 4 visible wheels.
Row3: gnarled dead stump with exposed roots; fallen hollow mossy log laid horizontally; tall swamp reeds and cattails; thick twisting ancient tree roots arching over earth.
Row4: violet cave crystal cluster; low turquoise cave mushroom colony; cracked cylindrical stone pillar fallen horizontally; abandoned wooden winch with rope coil.
NATIVE scale compared with reference: character is 32px high; arches about48pxhigh, columns40px, reeds28px, boulder30px; do not fill every cell uniformly with giant objects. Spring base version. Source art goes arte/fontes/fendas; runtime cropped fixed64 cells assets/cenario/fendas/decoracao, seasonal versions keep same geometry and pivot; collisions only solid foot bases; outside traversable corridors. This is an actual pixel sprite sheet, not a concept board.
prompts.edicao: Simplificar em grupos de pixels, remover franjas e preservar os 16 objetos e sua ordem.
